Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring child fatality reviews for children involved in the child welfare system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to child fatality reviews for children involved inthe child welfare system; and adding a new section to chapter 74.13RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of social and health services shall conduct achild fatality review in the event of an unexpected death of a minor inthe state who is in the care of or receiving services described inchapter 74.13 RCW from the department or who has been in the care of orreceived services described in chapter 74.13 RCW from the departmentwithin one year preceding the minor's death. (2) Upon conclusion of a child fatality review required pursuant tosubsection (1) of this section, the department shall issue a report onthe results of the review to the appropriate committees of thelegislature and shall make copies of the report available to the publicupon request. p. 1 SHB 2984 (3) The department shall develop and implement procedures to carryout the requirements of subsections (1) and (2) of this section.
